security_audit.summary: Manual adjudication confirmed unsafe archive extraction in Office-file helpers and privileged install guidance in the skill documentation. Most other static hits are false positives from Markdown backticks, OOXML namespace URLs, schema imports, validation messages, or expected temporary-file workflows. One additional medium semantic issue was identified: relationship target validation should enforce package-root containment after path resolution.

remediation.issue: Unsafe archive extraction in OOXML helpers
remediation.suggestion: Replace extractall with member-by-member extraction that rejects absolute paths, parent-directory traversal, symlinks, and resolved paths outside the destination directory.
Remove sudo commands from automatic skill workflows and document LibreOffice and Poppler as manual prerequisites that require explicit user approval.

remediation.issue: Relationship target validation lacks containment enforcement
remediation.suggestion: After resolving each relationship target, verify it remains under the unpacked package root before checking existence or accepting it as valid.

remediation.issue: External converters process local presentation files
remediation.suggestion: Run LibreOffice, Poppler, Chromium, and XML validation workflows in an isolated workspace with timeouts, limited permissions, and no sensitive working-directory contents.

content.value_statement: PowerPoint work often requires precise layout, XML edits, and visual checks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through PPTX creation, editing, validation, and thumbnail review.
actual_capabilities: Create new PPTX decks from HTML slides with html2pptx and PptxGenJS guidance.
Edit existing PowerPoint files by unpacking, inspecting, modifying, and repacking OOXML package contents.
Extract presentation text, speaker notes, comments, themes, layouts, and slide XML for analysis.
Generate thumbnail grids with LibreOffice and Poppler to review slide layout and visual quality.
Validate OOXML structure, relationships, content types, and schema conformance after edits.
Analyze templates, inventory slide shapes, rearrange layouts, and replace placeholder text.
limitations: Requires local Python, Node, LibreOffice, Poppler, and related presentation libraries for full workflows.
Some workflows execute helper scripts and external conversion tools on local presentation files.
Complex animations, embedded media, and advanced PowerPoint features may require manual OOXML inspection.
Archive extraction helpers need stronger path validation before use with untrusted Office files.

use_cases.title: Generate a Client Deck
use_cases.description: Build a polished PowerPoint deck from structured content, charts, and a chosen visual style.

use_cases.title: Update a Template Deck
use_cases.description: Analyze a branded template, map slide placeholders, and replace content while preserving design structure.

use_cases.title: Repair and Validate Slides
use_cases.description: Inspect raw OOXML, fix broken relationships or layout issues, and validate the presentation before delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-slide PowerPoint deck about [topic]. Use a clear visual hierarchy, readable colors, and thumbnail validation before finalizing.

prompt_templates.title: Match an Existing Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze template.pptx, create a slide inventory, choose suitable layouts, and build a new deck for [audience] using the template style.

prompt_templates.title: Edit Existing Slides
prompt_templates.prompt: Unpack presentation.pptx, update the title and speaker notes on slides [numbers], validate the OOXML, and repack the file.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Layout and XML Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this PPTX for text overflow, broken relationships, missing content types, and visual layout problems. Explain each fix and validate the result.

output_examples.input: A request to create a product update deck from a short outline.
output_examples.output: A finished PPTX with consistent slide layouts, readable typography, charts, speaker notes, and reviewed thumbnail images.

output_examples.input: A branded template and replacement content for selected slides.
output_examples.output: An updated deck that preserves template styling, replaces placeholder text, and reports any layout or overflow concerns.

output_examples.input: A PPTX file with broken comments, notes, or relationship references.
output_examples.output: A repaired presentation package with validation results and a concise summary of corrected OOXML files.

best_practices: Use copies of presentations and keep the original file unchanged until validation passes.
Generate thumbnails after each major layout change and inspect text overlap, cutoff, and contrast.
Validate OOXML immediately after edits so relationship and schema errors are found early.
anti_patterns: Do not run helper scripts on untrusted Office files without sandboxing and safe archive extraction.
Do not skip visual thumbnail review when generated slides contain dense text, charts, or tables.
Do not edit raw XML without validating relationships, content types, and package structure afterward.

faq.question: Can this skill create a new PowerPoint file?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides HTML-to-PPTX generation with PptxGenJS and then recommends visual validation with thumbnails.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing PPTX file?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to unpack the Office package, edit OOXML files, validate changes, and repack the presentation.

faq.question: Does it support speaker notes and comments?
faq.answer: Yes. The OOXML workflow includes notes slides, comments, slide layouts, themes, and relationship files.

faq.question: Does it require external software?
faq.answer: Yes. Full workflows may require Python packages, Node packages, LibreOffice, Poppler, Playwright, Sharp, and PptxGenJS.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted presentations?
faq.answer: Use caution. The current archive extraction helpers should add path validation before processing untrusted PPTX or DOCX files.

faq.question: What is the best way to check slide quality?
faq.answer: Create thumbnail grids after generation or editing, then inspect for text cutoff, overlap, spacing, and contrast problems.
